enemy-081-albino-siege-royal.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed enemy-029 Siege Royal. Preserve one heavy upright biped at Praetorian scale with a substantially thick ribbed torso, pelvis, thighs, forearms and shoulders; one broad low layered royal crest swept backward, clearly smaller and less ornate than a Queen crown and never a Crusher head shield; one narrow eyeless anterior dome and toothed maw with inner jaw; exactly TWO main arms, TWO digitigrade legs and exactly four short reduced dorsal tubes below the crest; and one complete long segmented siege tail visibly rooted at a thick sacrum and ending in one sharp spear tip. Albino changes newly authored organic pigment/material response only: warm pearl and pale parchment carapace, cool ash-gray wet recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe joints, chalk-ivory crest edges and teeth, with sparse neutral gray-brown battle wear. Heavy siege mass, crest contour, limb count, dorsal-tube count, sacral tail root, scale and right-facing profile remain invariant. No Queen secondary chest arms or ovipositor, Crusher shield/quadruped posture, armor, weapon, jewellery, cannon, cybernetics, pure white, glow, ice, copied predecessor pixels, official-model claim or 1:1 claim. Every future pixel is newly authored project art; canonExact=false.

designDetails.silhouette: Heavy upright biped with thick shoulders, forearms, ribcage, pelvis and thighs; broad low layered swept-back crest, four short reduced dorsal tubes and one complete spear tail rooted at the sacrum.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl/parchment chitin, cool ash-gray wet recesses, restrained rose-taupe joints, chalk-ivory crest edges and teeth, and sparse neutral gray-brown wear. Never flat white, icy blue or luminous.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless crested head and inner jaw, exactly two main arms, two digitigrade legs, four short dorsal tubes and one segmented spear tail. There are no small inner/chest arms.
designDetails.separation: Thicker and more siege-built than an Albino Praetorian; smaller and simpler crown than a Queen; upright and two-legged rather than a Crusher quadruped with a head shield.
designDetails.orientation: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Crest, both feet, both hands and the entire tail remain inside every cell with generous gutters.
designDetails.root: New art requires 40 independent pelvis/proximal-leg-to-support-foot or terminal-body-plane anchors. Crest edge, tail tip, bounds center and inherited enemy-029 coordinates are forbidden root proxies.
designDetails.scale: New art requires independent inter-clip calibration using the rigid main cranial-plate base, shoulder-to-pelvis and proximal-limb landmarks. Do not inherit enemy-029 numeric factors or measure crest/tail/action extrema.
designDetails.background: True alpha or perfectly uniform #FF00FF only; no floor, cast shadow, hive, scenery, checkerboard, grid, text, logo or UI.
